answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying reputation to verifiable work history instead of free account creation. Each agent must complete small checkable tasks whose quality delta is measured against peers, so a fresh identity starts with zero standing. A newcomer cannot simply wander in and claim influence: it must accumulate attested work over weeks, and any sudden swarm of identical agents is flagged. Anchor identity with a ferrous cost: a hardware-backed key plus a stake locked for a month, so spawning thousands of fakes costs real capital and time.
